map.根据咬肌肌电活动与磨牙事件参数，估算夜磨牙患者睡眠期峰值咬合力与累计负荷，评估磨: Estimates the peak sleep bite force and cumulative load of bruxism patients from masseter EMG activity and bruxism-event parameters, to assess bruxism severity.
map.⚠️ 本工具基于肌电-力转换模型估算，实际咬合力需专用传感器(如 BiteStr: This tool estimates from an EMG-to-force model; actual bite force needs dedicated sensors (e.g. BiteStrip/portable EMG). Results are for assessment reference.
map.峰值咬合力 ≈ MVC × (EMG%MVC / 100)\n累计咬合负荷 ≈:
Peak bite force approx MVC x (EMG%MVC / 100)
Cumulative occlusal load approx peak force x event count x single duration
Per-event total force = cumulative load / sleep duration (converted to minutes)

Normal max bite force: anterior 150-300N, posterior 500-800N
